     BUSINESS REVIEW                                                                  業務回顧
     As a pioneer and key promoter of pop toy culture in China, despite affected      作為中國潮流玩具文化的開拓者及主要推廣
     by the recurrence of COVID-19 pandemic, we still maintain fast growth of         者，在COVID-19 疫情不斷反覆的影響下，我
     our business and experienced a year-on-year increase of 78.7% in revenue in      們仍保持業務的高速增長，2021 年收入同比增
     2021. At the same time, we accumulated 19.58 million registered members.         長 78.7%，同時累計註冊會員總數達到 1,958.0
     According to the 2021 China Pop Toy Market Development Report issued the         萬人。根據中國社會科學院國情調查與大數據
     National Situation Investigation and Big Data Research Center of the Chinese     研究中心發佈《2021 中國潮流玩具市場發展報
     Academy of Social Sciences, the emergence and development of pop toys            告》，近年來潮流玩具的出現與發展受到了經
     in recent years has been effected by the economy development, technical          濟發展、技術變革、消費觀念轉變、Z 世代崛
     revolution, the change of consumption concept, the rise of Z Generation          起等多重因素的影響。潮流玩具具有社交、收
     and other factors. Thanks to their socializing, collecting and entertaining      藏、娛樂等社會屬性，正成為新一代年輕人休

     The Relevant Businesses of Paqu Huyu are subject to foreign investment           葩趣互娛的相關業務受相關中國法律法規之外

     directly hold any equity ownership in Paqu Huyu. Instead, we decided that,       反，我們認為，根據受外商投資限制規限的中
     in line with common practice in industries in the PRC subject to foreign         國行業慣例，透過北京泡泡瑪特（本公司於中國
     investment restrictions, we would gain effective control over, and receive all   成立的全資附屬公司，作為一方）與葩趣互娛及
     the economic benefits generated by the business currently operated by Paqu       相關股東（作為另一方）之間的合約安排，我們
     Huyu through the Contractual Arrangements between Beijing Pop Mart, a            將獲得對葩趣互娛的實際控制權，並取得葩趣
     wholly-owned subsidiary of our Company established in the PRC, on the one        互娛目前經營的業務所產生的所有經濟利益。

    leakage and other waste of water, and deal with malfunction once                  源浪費的情況發生，發現故障並及時
    identified in a timely manner;                                                    處理；


•   Install water-saving taps on water facilities for water-saving                •   對用水設備進行節水改造，逐步安裝
    retrofitting, so as to adjust the water pressure of taps and control              節水龍頭，調整水龍頭水壓，控制水
    water velocity;                                                                   龍頭的水流速度；


•   Develop and post water-saving slogans in office area to enhance               •   製作並張貼節水標識，加強員工在日
    the awareness of staff on water conservation and help them                        常工作與生活中的水資源節約意識，
    cultivate water-saving habits in daily work and life, and call on staff           培養員工節水習慣，號召員工隨手關

Setting Environmental Goals                                                              環境目標規劃

based on that progress, so as to fully implement the environmental                       保護措施。
protection measures.


  Emission reduction           By the end of 2030, the greenhouse gas emissions (Scope 1 and 2)(1) of the Company will reach a
      goal                     carbon dioxide emission peak.
  減排目標                         截至2030年底，本公司範圍一及範圍二 (1) 溫室氣體排放實現碳達峰。
  Waste reduction goal         By the end of 2022, the distributing of the orders will be fully online. Roboshops will implement a
  減廢目標                         paperless office model.
                               截至2022年底，全面實現配貨單線上化，機器人商店工作人員實行無紙化辦公。
                               By the end of 2023, at least 90% of the packaging cartons generated in stores will be collected and
                               recycled by the Company or by qualified third parties.
                               截至2023年底，至少90%門店產生的包裝紙箱被本公司或者有資質的第三方回收利用。

                               截至2025年底，人均辦公耗電量較2020年減少10%。

   there is a reasonable assurance that the grant will be received, and the        本集團將符合所有附帶條件，則政府補貼
   Group will comply with all attached conditions.                                 將按其公平值確認。


   Government grants relating to expenses are deferred and recognised in           有關開支的政府補貼將予遞延，並在按配
   the profit or loss or deducted against related expenses over the period         合擬補償的開支所需期間內於損益確認或
   necessary to match them with the expenses that they are intended to             自相關開支中扣除。
   compensate.


   Government grants relating to costs are deferred and recognised in              有關成本的政府補貼將予遞延，並在按配
   the consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive            合擬補償的成本所需期間內於綜合損益及
   income over the period necessary to match them with the costs that              其他全面收益表確認。
   they are intended to compensate.

   financial assets that are held for cash management purposes, see Note 9         利息收入，利息收入則呈列為財務收入（請
   below. Any other interest income is included in other income.                   參閱下文附註 9）。任何其他利息收入乃計
                                                                                   入其他收入。


   Interest income is calculated by applying the effective interest rate to        利息收入的計算方法是將實際利率應用於
   the gross carrying amount of a financial asset except for financial assets      金融資產的賬面總值，但隨後發生信貸減
   that subsequently become credit-impaired. For credit-impaired financial         值的金融資產除外。對於信貸減值的金融
   assets the effective interest rate is applied to the net carrying amount of     資產，實際利率應用於金融資產的賬面淨
   the financial asset (after deduction of the loss allowance).                    值（經扣除虧損撥備）。

3.2 Capital management                                                          3.2 資本管理
   The Group’s objectives when managing capital are to safeguard the              本集團管理資本之目的為維持其持續經營
   Group’s ability to continue as a going concern in order to provide             的能力，以便為本集團擁有人提供回報，
   returns for owners of the Group and to maintain an optimal capital             並維持最佳的資本架構以提高擁有人的長
   structure to enhance owners’ value in the long term.                           期價值。


   The Group monitors capital on the basis of the gearing ratio. This ratio       本集團按照資本負債率監控資本。該比率
   is calculated as net debt divided by total capital. Net debt is calculated     按債務淨額除以總資金計算。債務淨額按
   as total borrowings less cash and cash equivalents. Total capital is           借款總額減去現金及現金等價物計算。總
   calculated as ‘equity’ as shown in the balance sheet plus net debt. As at      資金按資產負債表所示「權益」加債務淨額
   31 December 2021 and 31 December 2020, the Group has no net debt.              計算。於2021年12月31日及2020年12月31
                                                                                  日，本集團並無債務淨額。
